helpers.name: getCurrentFormat
helpers.expression:
function getCurrentFormat(editor: Editor): BlockFormat | 'other' {
    if (editor.isActive('heading', { level: 1 })) return 'h1'
    if (editor.isActive('heading', { level: 2 })) return 'h2'
    if (editor.isActive('heading', { level: 3 })) return 'h3'
    if (editor.isActive('paragraph')) return 'paragraph'
    return 'other'
}

            editor,

            selector: ({
                editor: currentEditor,
            }) => {
                const isHeader =
                    currentEditor.isActive(
                        'tableHeader'
                    )

                const cellAttributes =
                    (
                        isHeader
                            ? currentEditor.getAttributes(
                                  'tableHeader'

                            : currentEditor.getAttributes(
                                  'tableCell'

                return {
                    canEdit: canEditTable(currentEditor),

                    addRowAfter: canTableAction(currentEditor, 'addRowAfter'),
                    deleteRow: canTableAction(currentEditor, 'deleteRow'),

                    mergeCells: canTableAction(currentEditor, 'mergeCells'),
                    splitCell: canTableAction(currentEditor, 'splitCell'),

                    toggleHeaderColumn: canTableAction(currentEditor, 'toggleHeaderColumn'),
                    toggleHeaderCell: canTableAction(currentEditor, 'toggleHeaderCell'),

effects:
useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) {
            return
        }

        const attributes =
            editor.getAttributes(
                'table'
            )

        const currentWidth =
            attributes.widthMode

        setWidthMode(
            currentWidth ===
                'auto' ||
                currentWidth ===
                    '50' ||
                currentWidth ===
                    '75'
                ? currentWidth
                : 'full'
        )

        setTableAlign(
            attributes.tableAlign ===
                'left' ||
                attributes.tableAlign ===
                    'right'
                ? attributes.tableAlign
                : 'center'
        )

        setCellPadding(
            Number(
                attributes.cellPadding ??
                10
            )
        )

        setBorderColor(
            attributes.borderColor ??
            '#d4d4d4'
        )

        setBorderWidth(
            Number(
                attributes.borderWidth ??
                1
            )
        )

        setBorderStyle(
            attributes.borderStyle ===
                'dashed' ||
                attributes.borderStyle ===
                    'dotted'
                ? attributes.borderStyle
                : 'solid'
        )
    }, [
        editor,
        open,
    ])
